ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (22) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Злорадство» (zloradstvo, 'malicious joy') is 'gloating', and Schopenhauer's «не я» (ne ya, 'not I') keeps the first person as printed. Tolstoy's «негры» (negry) is kept as 'Negroes', the period word, without modernizing.

Source observation: [10] The paragraph «Один тип разделяет нас…» ('One type separates us…') continues Schopenhauer's passage but is printed after the attribution «Шопенгауэр.» and without the quote marker; possibly a misplaced attribution. Translated as printed.
